And 6 Others on 6 August, 2025 Author: Saral Srivastava Bench: Saral Srivastava High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:132418-Db Court No. - 40 Case :- Writ - C No. - 26096 of 2025 Petitioner :- Anwar Uddin @ Mohd. Anwar Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 6 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Mohd Irteqa Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Manoj Kumar Singh,Vibhu Rai Hon'ble Saral Srivastava,J. Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J. 1.
texts.facts: The petitioner by means of the present petition has assailed the order cancelling the F.S.S. Certificate No.22725594000057. 5. Since, there is statutory remedy of filingappeal under Regulation 2.1.12 of Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations 2011 against the ordercancelling the F.S.S. Registration Certificate, therefore, present petition is not maintainable before this Court.
texts.arguments: 3. A preliminary objection has been raised by Sri Vibhu Rai, learned counsel for respondent-Nagar Nigam that against the order cancelling the F.S.S. Registration Certificate, there is a statutory remedy of appeal under Regulation 2.1.12 of Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations 2011. 4.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. A preliminary objection has been raised by Sri Vibhu Rai, learned counsel for respondent-Nagar Nigam that against the order cancelling the F.S.S. Registration Certificate, there is a statutory remedy of appeal under Regulation 2.1.12 of Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations 2011. 4.
